relations.justification: Long-lived digital geometry requires a documented exchange format; a model in a proprietary format is a hostage to its vendor.
Digital models superseded the drawing as the authoritative definition of a part; the drawing became a derived view.
Compression is applied to formats; what a container permits bounds what compression can be used.
Practical lossless compression is source coding; the algorithms in a preservation toolkit are the theorems of information theory implemented.
Backup design trades compression against recoverability, so the compression properties are prior.
Key management exemplifies the coordination problem: a secret shared by too few is lost and by too many is not a secret.
Long-term access to encrypted material is conditional on key survival; key loss is the commonest cause of permanent data loss.
An encrypted backup is only as recoverable as its key management, which is an encryption question.
A backup strategy that is never restore-tested is not a backup; verification is a constituent of the practice, not an optional addition.
Offsite copies depend on the cross-border transfer regime once the offsite location is in another jurisdiction.
Forensic soundness requires a documented chain of custody, which is an access-and-rights discipline before it is a technical one.
